sql: /* Query 11: filter6_agg1_join1 (player, team) */ SELECT player.position, SUM(player.mvp_awards) AS sum_player_mvp_awards FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name WHERE (player.team <> 'Houston Rockets' AND player.nba_championships > 2) OR (team.founded_year <> 1949 AND team.championship <> 1) GROUP BY player.position

mvp_awards.description: number of NBA MVP awards the player has won; use 0 if none (e.g., 2).

position.description: player's primary position on the team; choose one from ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'].
